item.question: Why might one choose to use LLM-A* over an LLM-only approach for pathfinding tasks?
item.answer: One might choose LLM-A* over an LLM-only approach because it combines global insights with deterministic guarantees, offering a balance between flexibility and reliability that results in superior performance regarding robustness and optimality.
